title: A way to rename skills like in Birth By Sleep?

posts.author: Dreigonix
posts.body: The title says it all-- I want to implement a way to let the player rename their skills ingame through a Name Input window, like the finisher commands in Birth By Sleep. Is there a plugin that can allow me to do that?

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
You can change the name of a skill by assigning it the name of an unused actor, which you can rename. Use the "Name Input" command and then insert the following script:
Code:
$dataSkills[IdSkill].name =$gameActors.actor(IdActor).name();
Replace IdSkill with the ID of the skill you want to rename.
Replace IdActor with the ID of the actor you just renamed.

I've heard it suggested by others that that might permanently change the skills' names even in New Games. Is that true?

posts.author: ISC
posts.body: No. This fetches the name of the skill from the database and replaces it with the name of an actor. Starting a new game resets everything to the initial state of the database

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
ISC said:
Use the "Name Input" command and then insert the following script:
Code:
$dataSkills[IdSkill].name =$gameActors.actor(IdActor).name();
Click to expand...
That won't work correctly. All $data arrays are loaded directly from the database when you boot the game.
That means:
1 - your change above will not be saved the next time the player runs the game
2 - it
will
persist into loading any other games or starting any new games until the player closes and reboots the game
This isn't doable without a plugin. Either one that saves skill names into objects that are referenced whenever they need to be drawn (preferable) or one that causes a common event to be run every time you load a game to do your script above (undesirable - you should avoid ever trying to modify $data objects during runtime).

posts.author: BlackGoldSaw
posts.body:
I don't know the nature of how you're allowing the player to rename Skills, but in regards to simply doing it and properly keeping the changes I use Victor Engine's Control Text Plugin. The Basic Module Plugin is needed for it as well:
VE_BasicModule
VE_ControlText
The Control Text Plugin will let you use Escape Codes in Skill names. Use a dummy Actor and after inputting a name, store that name in a Variable.
This example stores the name of Actor 1 as a String inside Variable 7:
JavaScript:
Name Input Processing : Harold, 8 Characters
Control Variables : #0007 = "$gameActors.actor(1).name()"
Then in the
Skill's Name Box
you use the Plugin's tag '
\#
' followed by the
Variable Escape Code
.
In this example the Skill's Name will  be whatever is stored in Variable 7:
JavaScript:
\#\v[7]
From there you'd repeat those steps using a
different Variable for each Skill
you want to rename.
